why.title: Why Learn With Us?
why.body: Everything you need to speak Amharic with confidence - from your first greeting to advanced conversation.

nativeTeachers.title: Native teachers
nativeTeachers.body: Learn from Amharic speakers who know how Ethiopia actually greets, negotiates, and hosts - not textbook phrases alone.

personalized.title: Personalized lessons
personalized.body: Your persona and progress shape every unit. Diplomats, NGO staff, and diaspora each get the framing that fits their work.

flexible.title: Flexible scheduling
flexible.body: Book live sessions around your calendar. Morning Addis, evening Toronto - times always show in your timezone.

online.title: Online via Meet
online.body: Join from Zoom or Google Meet with the same curriculum your teacher prepared from - no wasted minutes catching up.

culture.title: Cultural immersion
culture.body: Every unit starts with culture: rank, hospitality, and when a phrase is right - then the language that belongs there.

homework.title: Homework that sticks
homework.body: Practice after every lesson with speaking, writing, and real-world tasks your teacher can review.

levels.title: Beginner to Advanced
levels.body: Six fidel levels from Foundations to Mastery, mapped to CEFR, with certificates embassies can verify.

levels.title: Six fidel levels. One clear path.
levels.body: Named after the Ethiopian syllabary, not CEFR codes - with the CEFR equivalent printed on every certificate.

how.tite: One curriculum. Two ways to learn.
how.body: Self-study and live teaching share the same path - so every minute with a teacher builds on what you already practiced.
how.selfBody: Open any unlocked unit. Culture, language, and practice - always available.
how.liveBody: Your teacher sees the same unit and what you already completed. No minute wasted.
how.certBody: Finish a level, pass the exam, get a PDF with a public verification code embassies can check.

parts.title: Three parts. One clear rhythm.
parts.body: Every Fidel unit follows the same arc - so learners and teachers always know what comes next.

culture.title: Cultural Insight
culture.body: Understand the situation before the words - rank, distance, hospitality, and when a phrase is right.
culture.point1: Context cards for real Ethiopian settings
culture.point2: What to do, not just what to say
culture.point3: Sets up the vocabulary that follows

language.title: Language Lesson
language.body: The phrases, patterns, and script work that belong in that situation - spoken Amharic first.

practice.title: Practice
practice.body: Use what you learned - listening, speaking, and checks that prepare you for a live session.
practice.point2: Speaking prompts you can book a teacher for
practice.point3: Clear completion so teachers know your progress

hybrid.body: Every unit moves from culture to language to practice. Book a teacher when you want feedback - they already know where you left off.
hybrid.feature1Body: Understand the situation first, then the words that belong in it.
hybrid.feature2Title: Live sessions that continue your path
hybrid.feature2Body: Teachers prepare from the same curriculum and your completed work.
hybrid.feature3Body: A public code on every PDF - no ambiguity for HR or protocol teams.
hybrid.mockCulture: Greetings carry rank, distance, and time of day - before any phrase list.
hybrid.mockReady: Practice complete. Book a live session on this unit when you want coaching.

about.title: Amharic for the work you actually do.
about.lead: Fidel is built for people who need Amharic that works in offices, embassies, NGOs, research sites, and family visits - not tourist phrasebooks.
about.p1: We organize learning into six fidel levels, named after the Ethiopian syllabary. Each level maps to a CEFR band so certificates stay readable for institutions abroad.
about.p2: Every unit follows culture → language → practice. That rhythm keeps self-study honest and makes live teaching efficient - your teacher sees the same curriculum and what you already finished.
about.p3: Accounts are provisioned by administrators. Request access, and we will set up your login when your organization is ready.
about.ctaBody: Tell us who you are learning for - embassy, NGO, university, or yourself.

services.title: One curriculum. Three ways we serve you.
services.lead: Whether you study alone, book a teacher, or need a certificate for protocol - Fidel keeps everything on the same path.
services.selfBody: Unlock units on your schedule. Culture, language, and practice are always available once entitled.
services.liveBody: Book coaches who prepare from your progress. No wasted minutes re-teaching what you already practiced.
services.certBody: Finish a level, pass the exam, receive a PDF with a public code embassies and HR can verify.
services.ctaBody: Request access for yourself or your organization.

contact.title: Let’s get you started.
contact.lead: Fidel accounts are created by an administrator. Request access, or email us if you represent an organization.
contact.accessBody: Share your role and organization. We will provision your account and send login details.
contact.emailBody: Questions about cohorts, pricing for organizations, or partnerships. Primary email: FidelTemari@gmail.com. Optional email: ayebisrat@gmail.com.
contact.note: Already invited? Use Log in from the navigation to activate your account. You can also call us at +251976502575.
